intro.h2: Google Review Management That Grows Your Reputation Honestly
paras: Before most people call a local business, they read its reviews. A steady flow of recent, genuine feedback tells them you are reliable, while a handful of old reviews or an unanswered complaint can send them elsewhere. Our Google review management service helps you collect more real reviews from happy customers and makes sure every review gets a thoughtful, professional reply.

Most businesses have plenty of satisfied customers who would happily leave a review. They simply are not asked, or they are asked at the wrong time with no easy link. We set up simple request systems using text messages, emails and QR code cards, timed for the moment a job is finished and the customer is pleased with the result.

Replies matter as much as the reviews themselves. Thanking customers by name shows you value them, and a calm, helpful response to a negative review often reassures future buyers more than another five-star rating. We write replies on your behalf in your tone of voice, and we handle difficult reviews carefully so your reputation is protected without arguing in public.

DigiRanx Pro is a new agency based in Wolverhampton, working with businesses in Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley, Telford and across the UK. We only ever help you gather real reviews from real customers. We never write fake reviews or offer incentives that break platform rules, because doing so risks penalties from Google and breaks UK consumer protection law.

why.h2: Why Online Reviews Decide Who Gets The Call
why.lead: Reviews influence both where you appear in local search and whether people choose you once they see you.

points.d: When several businesses appear side by side in Google Maps, reviews are often the deciding factor. People look at the star rating, how many reviews you have, how recent they are and how you respond when something goes wrong.

Google treats the number, quality and freshness of reviews as part of your prominence in local search. A business that receives genuine reviews regularly sends a clear signal that it is active and trusted by real customers.

Unanswered reviews, especially negative ones, suggest nobody is paying attention. A short, professional reply shows you care about service and gives you a chance to tell your side of the story calmly and briefly.

When you are busy, asking for reviews is the first thing to slip. A simple system that asks automatically at the right moment means reviews keep arriving every week without you having to remember to chase them.

benefits.h2: What Our Review Management Service Includes
benefits.lead: A complete system for collecting genuine feedback and handling every review professionally.

items.d: We set up review requests by text, email and QR code, each with a direct link to your review form. Growth plans automate the SMS and email requests so customers are asked consistently after every completed job or purchase.

Starter covers Google review management. Growth manages up to three platforms, including Google, Facebook and Trustpilot, in one place. Premium covers unlimited platforms for businesses where customers leave feedback in several different places.

We reply to every review on your behalf, thanking happy customers personally and avoiding copy-and-paste responses. Growth and Premium plans include replies within 24 hours, so new feedback never sits unanswered for long.

We answer unhappy reviews calmly, without arguing or sharing private details, and offer to take the conversation offline. Where a review clearly breaks platform policy, we request its removal through the proper channels on your behalf.

Growth plans include a website widget that displays your best recent reviews, plus printed QR code cards you can hand to customers or leave on the counter. Both make it easier to show and gather genuine feedback.

Each month you see your rating trend, new review count and any themes that keep coming up. Premium plans add negative review alerts, sentiment analysis and a quarterly strategy call to plan improvements across locations.

steps.h2: How We Set Up And Run Your Review Management
steps.lead: A simple process that fits around how you already work with customers.

items.d: We look at your current reviews on Google and other platforms, your average rating, how recent your reviews are and how replies have been handled. We then recommend the plan and platforms that make sense for your business.
You give us manager access to your profiles, so ownership stays with you. We agree how replies should sound, how to sign them off and which issues you want flagged to you before we respond.

We create request templates, direct review links and QR code cards, and connect automated SMS and email requests where your plan includes them. We make sure every request follows Google's rules and asks all customers fairly.

Once live, we monitor new reviews and reply to each one in your agreed tone. Anything serious, such as a complaint about safety or a legal issue, is passed straight to you before we post any public response.

Each month we send a report on new reviews, rating trend and common feedback themes. We use it to refine request timing and wording, and point out service issues worth fixing that customers keep mentioning.

faqs.q: Can I Offer A Discount For Leaving A Review?
faqs.a: No. Google does not allow businesses to offer incentives in exchange for reviews, and selectively asking only happy customers to review is also against its policies. Our request systems ask customers fairly and simply make leaving a review quick and easy, which is usually all that is needed.

faqs.a: Yes. Our Premium plan covers multiple locations and unlimited platforms, with negative review alerts and sentiment analysis so you can compare how each branch is performing. It suits businesses with several sites across the West Midlands or elsewhere in the UK.
